column3: NASB supplies “tribute,” and “toward the wilderness” becomes “by way of the wilderness.”
“A nest sent away” is rendered “scattered nestlings.”
“My outcasts, Moab” is rendered “the outcasts of Moab.”
“Struck down” is rendered “trampled down,” and NASB adds “as well.”
“I weep” is rendered “I will weep bitterly.”
“Will be removed” is rendered in the present, “are taken away”; “orchard” as “fruitful field.”
“Inward parts … make a sound” is rendered “my heart intones,” and “Kir Heres” as “Kir-hareseth.”
“Like the years of a hired laborer” is rendered “as a hired man would count them”; “little smallness not mighty” as “very small and impotent.”
